steps.text: If the player does not have a book in their inventory:

steps.npc: Here take this, you might find it useful.

steps.text: You are handed the rat pits manual.

steps.npc: What do you want to know?

options.text: Do you have any pointers for me and my cat?

steps.player: Do you have any pointers for me and my cat?

steps.npc: You should wear an Amulet of Catspeak. It will allow you to organise tactics with your cat.

steps.player: What would be the best tactic to adopt then?

steps.npc: Well, that depends on your outlook, whether you're ready to risk your cat's life or not and how defensive or aggressive you want your cat to be.

options.text: I will not risk my cat's life.

steps.player: I will not risk my cat's life.

steps.npc: Well if that's the case then you're left with two choices.
You can adopt an ultra defensive strategy, which increases your cat's hitpoints and defence but causes it to flee sooner.
Or you can adopt a less defensive strategy, which will allow your cat to stay in the pit for longer.

options.text: I think I would adopt an ultra defensive strategy.

steps.player: I think I would adopt a very defensive strategy

steps.npc: In that case you should tell your cat: 'Just take care of yourself, cat.'

steps.player: Thanks for your help.

steps.npc: Do you have any other questions about the pits?

options.text: I think I would adopt a less defensive strategy.

steps.player: I think I would adopt a less defensive strategy.

steps.npc: In that case you should tell your cat: 'Stay in for as long as you can.'

steps.player: Thanks for your help.

steps.npc: Do you have any other questions about the pits?

options.text: I am willing to risk my cat if it improves my chances.

steps.player: I am willing to risk my cat, if it increases my chances of victory.

steps.npc: In that case you are left with two choices.
You could go for all out attack which will boost your cat's attack and strength, but weaken it.
Or, go for a less aggressive stance, which will increase your cat's strength and attack to a lesser degree, but carries no defensive penalties.

options.text: I think I would adopt a very aggressive strategy.

steps.player: I think I would adopt a very aggressive strategy.

steps.npc: In that case you should tell your cat: 'Go berserk!'

steps.player: Thanks for your help.

steps.npc: Do you have any other questions about the pits?

options.text: I think I would adopt a less aggressive strategy.

steps.player: I think I would adopt a less aggressive strategy.

steps.npc: In that case you should tell your cat: 'No guts, no glory!'

steps.player: Thanks for your help.

steps.npc: Do you have any other questions about the pits?

options.text: What benefits does my cat get from training in the pits?

steps.player: What benefits does my cat get from training in the pits?

steps.npc: It depends on what kind of cat you have.
In the Port Sarim pits, your cat will become happier and fitter after fighting.

steps.player: Thanks for your help.

steps.npc: Do you have any other questions about the pits?

steps.player: No thanks.

options.text: Can you tell me more about wily cats?

steps.player: Can you tell me more about Wily cats?

steps.npc: Of course!
They're tougher, stronger and faster than other kinds of cats. They have superior hunting skills and can even catch butterflies and kalphite larvae.

steps.player: So are there any drawbacks to owning them?

steps.npc: Wily cats need lots more exercise, otherwise they'll get fat and lazy.

steps.player: What's the best way to exercise them?

steps.npc: Bring it hunting or take it to the Rat Pits regularly.
Try and keep it happy too, wily cats can be a little nasty when they're cranky.

steps.player: What happens if I neglect my cat? Not that I would!

steps.npc: It'll get fat and lazy and become much worse at hunting. Plus, everyone will know you're a bad cat trainer.

steps.player: Can I retrain my lazy cat?

steps.npc: Yes, you can get your lazy cat back in shape with lots of rat catching. But you really shouldn't let things get that bad.

steps.player: How's the poem going?

steps.npc: Ah yes, the poem... your performance was incredibly inspiring. I think it'll be a real masterpiece...
Just as soon as I get around to writing it all down.

historical-dialogue-during-ratcatchers-a.player: Hello, the face said that you were looking to talk with me.

historical-dialogue-during-ratcatchers-a.npc: Indeed, word has gotten to me from our other ratcatcher chapters that you are quite a talent.

historical-dialogue-during-ratcatchers-a.player: Well I can't take all the credit, I've had more than a little help from my cat.

historical-dialogue-during-ratcatchers-a.npc: Modesty, a trait seldom displayed by adventurers these days.
Too many more like you and I'll lose half of my business.

historical-dialogue-during-ratcatchers-a.player: Why is that?

historical-dialogue-during-ratcatchers-a.npc: Epic poems of bravery and heroics aren't usually commissioned by the shy and retiring.

historical-dialogue-during-ratcatchers-a.player: Smokin' Joe said that you know lots about training wily cats.

historical-dialogue-during-ratcatchers-a.npc: Indeed I do. It's for this very reason that I requested to talk to you.

historical-dialogue-during-ratcatchers-a.player: So you will show me how to turn my cat into a wily cat?
Sighs.*

historical-dialogue-during-ratcatchers-a.npc: No I need you to carry out just one task for me.

historical-dialogue-during-ratcatchers-a.player: Well experience has taught me to expect as much, what must I do?

historical-dialogue-during-ratcatchers-a.npc: Nothing too difficult, just rid the port of every single rat, with just one action.

historical-dialogue-during-ratcatchers-a.player: What?
Are you serious?

historical-dialogue-during-ratcatchers-a.text: You see a manic glint in her eye which you had previously missed.

historical-dialogue-during-ratcatchers-a.player: But why? Why one stroke, why not a slow eradication?

historical-dialogue-during-ratcatchers-a.npc: I want to write a new poem.

historical-dialogue-during-ratcatchers-a.player: But...
I am touched that you want to write an epic poem about me, but why can't you write the poem about seagulls or daffodils or something?

historical-dialogue-during-ratcatchers-a.npc: Well seagulls rarely make good central characters. They're a bit too ... uhm.... flighty.
Besides the poem is about me not you.

historical-dialogue-during-ratcatchers-a.player: Sorry I don't follow.

historical-dialogue-during-ratcatchers-a.npc: I myself carried out the very same feat once upon a time.

historical-dialogue-during-ratcatchers-a.player: So why do you need me to repeat your most heroic of feats?

historical-dialogue-during-ratcatchers-a.npc: It's all about objectivity and integrity. I need to be utterly divorced from the process.

historical-dialogue-during-ratcatchers-a.player: Umm... ok, I suppose.
So can you tell me how you went about achieving this?
Sigh* Why does it always have to be like this?

historical-dialogue-during-ratcatchers-b.npc: You haven't completed the task yet.

historical-dialogue-during-ratcatchers-b.player: What do I have to do again?

historical-dialogue-during-ratcatchers-b.npc: Rid the port of all its rats with one action.

historical-dialogue-during-ratcatchers-b.player: I'd better get to it then.

historical-dialogue-during-ratcatchers-a.player: I think I know how to carry out the task.

historical-dialogue-during-ratcatchers-a.npc: Has the face being telling tall tales again?

historical-dialogue-during-ratcatchers-a.player: Oh no, she didn't say a word.
Really she didn't.

historical-dialogue-during-ratcatchers-o.player: Ha! I did it. Did you see me?

historical-dialogue-during-ratcatchers-o.npc: Yes I saw that, now what can I do for you? Don't keep me overly long, I'm trying to complete my poem.

historical-dialogue-during-ratcatchers-o.player: Can you show me how to train my cat into a wily cat?
